**Movable centre zone.** You asked for it several times: the full-resolution zone no longer has to sit in the middle of the screen. Two new sliders place it anywhere, horizontally and vertically.

This is made for driving and cockpit games like **Forza Horizon** or **BeamNG.drive**. The road, the car and the dashboard sit in the lower part of the screen, and the sky above gains nothing from DLSS 5. Lower the zone, make it shorter, and NR spends its pixels where you actually look.

> **Pre-release.** The centre placement is new and has not been tested in a game yet. Feedback from racing games is welcome.

## Install

1. Download `renodx-dlss5.addon64` below.
2. In the game folder, **replace** `renodx-dlss5.addon64`. Everything else stays as in [v0.1.0](https://github.com/maximedgoulet/FoveatedDLSS5/releases/tag/v0.1.0).
3. RHI users: don't Refresh after copying, or RHI may put its own `renodx-dlss5.addon64` back.

Your settings carry over. The new position settings start at 50 %, the middle, so nothing changes until you move them.

## What's new

ReShade overlay → Add-ons → **DLSS 5 Neural Rendering** → under **Foveated resolution**:

| Overlay | `ReShade.ini` key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Centre vertical position | `NRFoveationCenterY` | `50` | `0` top, `50` middle, `100` bottom. |
| Centre horizontal position | `NRFoveationCenterX` | `50` | `0` left, `50` middle, `100` right. |

A good starting point for racing on a 7680×2160 screen:

```ini
[RenoDX.DLSS5]
NRFoveation=1
NRFoveationWidth=3000
NRFoveationHeight=1100
NRFoveationCenterY=62
```

The sharp zone then covers rows 789–1889, from the horizon down to the dash, and NR works on about **61 %** of the pixels instead of 71 % with the default zone. On other screens, set the height to cover the road and dashboard, then move the zone down until the top of the zone sits just above the horizon.

## Safeguards

- **The zone never leaves the screen.** Pushing it past an edge stops it flush with that edge. The readout under the sliders shows the position actually used.
- **Out-of-range values are fixed on load.** Anything outside 0–100 in `ReShade.ini` is clamped; a broken value falls back to 50.
- **Moving the zone restarts NR cleanly.** Every NR pass (multipass included) resets its history and the working size is recomputed, so there is never a stale mapping. Expect the same brief shimmer as the other foveation sliders while dragging.
- **Positions snap to whole pixels**, so tiny slider jitter doesn't reset NR.

## Also in this release

- The add-on builds with Clang again (a linker crash on one internal variable). No change for players: release builds use MSVC.

## Known limits

- After-upscale NR only; NR before upscaling keeps the normal uniform resolution.
- Changing foveation settings resets NR's temporal history (brief shimmer while dragging).
- New overlay text is English only.

All settings are explained in the [README](https://github.com/maximedgoulet/FoveatedDLSS5#settings).

Verify the download against `renodx-dlss5.addon64.sha256`.
